title: Testing: extract pure functions into utils.rs module
body:
Extract testable pure functions from component files into a shared utils.rs module to simplify testing and avoid pulling in Yew dependencies.

Functions to extract from components/editor.rs: slug_from_path, title_from_slug, sanitize_filename, char_pos_to_byte_offset, parent_dir, generate_template
Functions to extract from components/dashboard.rs: format_size
